name: COBAMAMIDE 1000 MCG 12 SACHETS
description: Cobamamide 1000 mcg is the active form of vitamin B12 (adenosylcobalamin) and is used to treat vitamin deficiencies, improve appetite, stimulate growth, and aid in weight gain, especially in cases of underweight. The presentation, containing 12 sachets of 1000 mcg each, is a freeze-dried powder to be dissolved in water, milk, or juice. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
